note: The script asks for seven text cards: the hook TODAY IS THE DAY and six cards, one per row, plus the CTA line on the end slide. The two match cards go on their own track.

mg.title: Hook: Today is the day
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: TODAY IS THE DAY
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:02. Centered, over the montage.

mg.title: Most wonderful day

text.main: The most wonderful day of giving is here.

mg.cue: Card at 00:02, centered, big: The most wonderful day of giving is here.
mg.use: Card from 00:02 to 00:06, centered, big. Keep it out of the bottom 20%.

mg.title: Today is Giving ShoesDay
mg.cue: Card at 00:06, centered, big: TODAY IS GIVING SHOESDAY
mg.use: Card from 00:06 to 00:10, centered, big. Keep it out of the bottom 20%.

mg.title: Match card 1
mg.cue: Card at 00:10, centered, big: All gifts are matched
mg.use: Card from 00:10 to 00:14, centered, big. Keep it out of the bottom 20%. Put it on its own match track.

mg.title: Match card 2: double

text.main: which means your donation has DOUBLE the impact!

mg.cue: Card at 00:14, centered, big: which means your donation has DOUBLE the impact!
mg.use: Card from 00:14 to 00:19, centered, big. Keep it out of the bottom 20%. Put it on its own match track.

mg.title: The goal

text.main: Together, we can give 2,500 kids new shoes.

mg.cue: Card at 00:19, centered, big: Together, we can give 2,500 kids new shoes.
mg.use: Card from 00:19 to 00:24, centered, big. Keep it out of the bottom 20%.

mg.title: Before the day ends

text.main: Help us hit our goal before the day ends.

mg.cue: Card at 00:24, centered, big: Help us hit our goal before the day ends.
mg.use: Card from 00:24 to 00:29, centered, big. Keep it out of the bottom 20%. Land it on the biggest reaction.

mg.title: End slide CTA
mg.cue: CTA text in the open middle of the slide, black, big: Donate today: link in bio or s4s.org
mg.src: Sydney's holiday end slide (Holiday_bkg_social_V1_2.jpg and V2_2.jpg on Drive, 22 Oct 2026) with the CTA line from her 19 Oct editing doc. The slide is not in endcards/ yet, so this graphic is the CTA text only.

lines: Donate today: link in bio or s4s.org

mg.use: Put Sydney's holiday slide at 00:29 and lay this CTA text over its open middle. Hold to the end. Black text on the light blue V1 slide; on the dark blue V2 slide type the same line in white. Add no logo: the wordmark is already on the slide.
